attr.text:
Baits happen, 
only look 
for the dark clone

You can also find it 
by finding the clone
 that isn't on cardinal
and looking opposite 
(since fire clone jumps)

Clones jump, dark by 
the wall is the new North

Ranged/healer: 

- If baiting dark, go 
in the center of 
the white boxes north, 
H1/R1 left, H2/R2 right

- If baiting fire, stack in the 
center of the white box, 
relative south west

You can follow both
or either of these 
clones to find the 
new north

If you follow one:

It jumps to the wall
-> New north

It jumps middle
-> New south, look 
opposite

Showing the bait 
distance for 
reference, it's 
pretty lenient
Cleaves don't matter, you can ignore them

Melee/tank:

- If baiting dark, go 
below the white line, one
box away from the middle.

- If baiting fire, stack on the 
northern line of the center box
(very important, don't go past
this line or you'll bait dark)
